title: Opinion: Opinion | Indian Firms Are Making Record Profits. Why Are Foreign Investors Still Leaving?
summary_full: In the July to September quarter of 2026-27, the 50 companies in the Nifty 50 increased profit after tax by 27% over the same quarter of the previous year - the highest growth in 17 quarters.
